Defined g on every color pair, proved its dot and three-strand intertwining identities with the faithful polynomial model, and gave every case of the QP induction: unequal last color, i after an unequal color with explicit braid-term cancellation, and two final i colors with the mixed-relation bracket equal to 1. Its polynomial has central color-symmetric coefficients and a uniform invertible leading scalar, proving injectivity on the finite projective comparison module. The exact resolution then licenses monic splitting, exactness, finite projective preservation and the functorial sequence, including lambda=0 and the vacuum. Source §4.3 Theorem 4.15 was checked in full, not imported as an unproved axiom.
